company.name: Weyland Energy GmbH
company.mission: We develop, build and operate wind, solar and storage assets that deliver affordable clean power to communities across Northern Europe.

harrow-bay.name: Harrow Bay Offshore Wind
harrow-bay.turbines: 40 × Halden HTS-12 (12 MW), rotor diameter 236 m, hub height 140 m
harrow-bay.foundations: Monopiles, 9.5 m diameter, water depth 28–36 m
harrow-bay.location: UK North Sea, 38 km off the coast of Harrow Bay
harrow-bay.export: 2 × 220 kV export cables, 62 km each, to onshore substation Harrow Bay East
milestones: Turbine supply agreement signed with Halden Turbine Systems
Final investment decision (FID) and financial close
Offshore construction start – first monopile installed
harrow-bay.key_risk: HB-RISK-017 – 8-week delay of export cable 2 delivery from Severn Subsea Cables (factory test failure, re-manufacture of 9 km section). Mitigation: resequence cable lay campaign, liquidated damages under contract WE-CON-2025-031.
harrow-bay.environment: Seabird and harbour porpoise monitoring by Marlow Ecology; piling noise mitigation with bubble curtains; piling paused during seasonal restrictions.

millbrook.name: Millbrook Solar & Storage
millbrook.storage: 20 MW / 40 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS)
millbrook.location: Millbrook, England – former arable farmland north of Millbrook village
top_concerns: visual impact from the public footpath

kestrel-ridge.name: Kestrel Ridge Wind Farm
kestrel-ridge.location: Scottish Borders, Kestrel Ridge plateau, 420–510 m elevation
kestrel-ridge.notable_event: T-07 gearbox bearing failure on 2026-01-14, turbine offline 23 days, gearbox exchanged under warranty (incident KR-INC-2026-003).

fenwick.name: Fenwick Battery Storage
fenwick.location: Fenwick, next to the existing 132 kV Fenwick substation
fenwick.status: Land option signed 2026-04-30; grid connection application submitted 2026-07; offer expected Q2 2027

hydrogen.name: Green Hydrogen Pilot
hydrogen.capacity: 5 MW PEM electrolyser at Port of Eastholm
hydrogen.status: Feasibility study completed 2026-08; funding application to the EU Innovation Fund in preparation

partners.turbine_supplier: Halden Turbine Systems A/S (Aarhus) – supplier of the HTS-12 12 MW offshore turbine
partners.cable_supplier: Severn Subsea Cables Ltd – 220 kV export and 66 kV array cables for Harrow Bay
partners.foundation_supplier: Rhenus Steelworks Foundations GmbH – monopiles and transition pieces
partners.installation_vessel: MV Sea Atlas (jack-up installation vessel, chartered from Atlas Marine Contractors)
partners.base_port: Port of Eastholm (construction and O&M base for Harrow Bay)
partners.ecology_consultant: Marlow Ecology Ltd (Bristol) – seabird, marine mammal and habitat surveys
partners.lender: Hanseatic Infrastructure Bank – lead arranger of the EUR 1.1 bn Harrow Bay project finance
partners.ppa_offtaker: Arcturus Steel AG – green steel producer, offtaker of WE-PPA-2026-004
partners.om_contractor: Highline Wind Services – O&M contractor for Kestrel Ridge
partners.solar_epc: SunForge EPC Ltd – preferred EPC bidder for Millbrook Solar & Storage
